description: Grafana itself: memory against its limit and OOM restarts, HTTP and datasource query performance, alert rule evaluation, and Go runtime. Metrics come from each replica's /metrics endpoint, cAdvisor and kube-state-metrics.

panels.description: Grafana pods Prometheus can scrape (2 expected).
panels.title: Replicas Up

panels.description: Time since the most recently started replica came up.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: Users active in the last 30 days (Grafana's own usage stat).
panels.title: Active Users

panels.description: Working-set memory of the fullest replica as a share of its memory limit.

targets.expr: max(max by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="grafana", container="grafana"}) / on (pod) max by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="grafana", container="grafana", resource="memory"}))

panels.title: Memory (current)

panels.description: Highest working-set memory of any replica in the selected range as a share of its limit. Close to 100% means a heavy dashboard nearly got Grafana OOM-killed.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="grafana", container="grafana"}[$__range]) / on (pod) group_left () max by (pod) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="grafana", container="grafana", resource="memory"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Memory (peak in range)

panels.description: Grafana container restarts in the selected range, all replicas.
panels.title: Restarts

panels.description: Restarts in the selected range of containers whose last termination reason was OOMKilled. kube-state-metrics only keeps the most recent reason, so a pod that OOMed and later crashed for another reason is not counted.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="grafana", container="grafana"}[$__range]) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left () max by (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace="grafana", container="grafana", reason="OOMKilled"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: OOM Kills

panels.description: Container working-set memory per pod (what the OOM killer compares) against the memory limit.
panels.title: Memory vs Limit per Pod

panels.description: Container restarts per pod within each interval (kube-state-metrics).
panels.title: Restarts

panels.description: Why each container last terminated, for pods that existed in the selected range (OOMKilled, Error, Completed...). Only the most recent reason per container is kept.
panels.title: Last Termination Reasons

panels.description: HTTP requests per second by status code, excluding health probes and Prometheus scrapes. -1 is a closed websocket.
panels.title: Requests by Status

panels.description: Latency of UI/API requests (health probes, /metrics and the live websocket excluded).
panels.title: Request Latency

panels.description: 95th percentile latency per route over the selected range. /api/ds/query is panel data; slow here usually means a slow datasource.
panels.title: Slowest Handlers (p95)

panels.description: Backend data queries per second per datasource type (panels and alert rules).
panels.title: Datasource Queries

panels.description: How long datasource queries take, measured inside Grafana.
panels.title: Datasource Query Latency

panels.description: Failed datasource queries. status_source=downstream means the datasource (Prometheus/Loki) returned the error, e.g. a bad query or timeout; plugin means Grafana itself failed.
panels.title: Datasource Errors

panels.description: Alert rule evaluations and failed evaluations per second per replica. Each replica evaluates every rule.
panels.title: Rule Evaluations

panels.description: Time to evaluate one alert rule (query plus condition).
panels.title: Rule Evaluation Duration

panels.description: Alert instances per state (normal omitted), max across replicas since both evaluate the same rules.
panels.title: Alert Instances by State

panels.description: Notifications delivered per contact point integration, summed over both replicas' alertmanagers.
panels.title: Notifications Sent

panels.description: CPU cores used per pod (cAdvisor) against the container CPU limit.
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Go heap in use per replica and the heap size that triggers the next GC. Working-set memory above this is caches, stacks and plugin processes.
panels.title: Go Heap

panels.description: Goroutines per replica (a steady climb suggests a leak) and open Grafana Live websocket connections (roughly one per open browser tab).
panels.title: Goroutines and Live Connections

panels.description: Grafana error-level log lines (Grafana logs at debug level, so the line filter matters).
panels.title: Grafana Errors

title: Grafana
